caption: The drawing features four distinct objects on a plain, off-white background. Each object appears to be a stylized, decorative form made of a wood-like material rendered in shades of beige and brown. At the top center is a heart-shaped object with a jagged, zigzag border and layered, triangular patterns inside. To the right of the heart is a leaf-shaped figure, pointing upward and featuring a similar jagged border, with diagonal ridges suggesting veins. Below the heart, on the left, is an elongated, curving shape that resembles a leaf or feather, also bordered by a zigzag pattern and filled with parallel grooves that follow its contour. At the bottom right is another leaf-shaped object, with a hooked end and an outward curve, sharing the jagged edge motif and lined interior. The name “FRITZ BOEHMER” is printed in thin, uppercase letters in the lower right corner of the image.
title: Pa. German Stamping Blocks for Homespun Cotton or Linens
